project_goal: Expand explanatory mechanisms without asserting scientific novelty: arbitrary mutual compatibility, temporal two-sided decisions, institutions/algorithms, private vs public rejection feedback, relationship duration and external evidence gate
R5: Stop if no new human evidence or synthetic hypotheses provide only prior-art illustration; 20 ceiling not target
research_level: All human claims require real independent evidence; synthetic only, no calibrated sociological parameters

source_design.compatibility: Mutual reported attraction scopes all/same/other across 3 synthetic genders, with restrictive F/M comparison only as counterfactual; demographic proportions arbitrary
source_design.directed_stage: Sender exposure, sender yes, recipient reply to yes, maximally matched exclusive partner, time-specific dissolution
source_design.stability: Exogenous per-dyad hazard with same fixed shocks across paired scenarios, not learned from human follow-up
source_design.randomness: Fixed potential uniforms per seed/time/sender/target for proposals, replies, recommendation and dissolution; state mediates future risk and available agents
source_design.candidate_matching: maxcardinality maximum-weight undirected matching on mutual edge with small fixed jitter; not stable/utility optimal
source_design.fixed_interventions: Each condition changes only named mechanism vs mixed_random with shared synthetic population and latent random shocks; dynamic trajectories diverge and budgets/exposure not pairwise equal after divergences
identified_mechanism_cautions: No external causal estimates; counterfactual code manipulation only
Public reputational penalty is intentionally visible to receiver, entirely stipulated; not evidence rejected people lose status in real world
Private feedback changes sender approval threshold, whereas public feedback changes receiver's appraisal of sender—two different estimands
Genders and scopes are invented synthetic categories; not estimates of LGBTQ+ prevalence or preferences
No welfare, coercion, wellbeing, safety outcomes measured
Duration averages exclude right-censored relationships and are biased, report censoring and use active prevalence as distinct metric
Source based on published papers means tests of novelty need stronger evidence

cycles.intent: Verify 2026 human papers: Hu/Markowitz option-set experiments, Fong field experiment market size/competition, Büyükeren/Makarin/Xiong AEJ Tinder outcomes and replication file access, Moreno/Finkel et al diadic first dates, Chen recommender; add SOURCES and update priors, rights/access honest
Implement generalized mutual-compatibility O, temporal stage sequence, distinguish public reputation from private learning and relationship exit with explicit scope and QA
Run synthetic null inclusive opportunity graph and restrictive F/M comparator, validate symmetric compatibility, matching and relationship accounting; no demographic claims
Compare opportunity group sorting with explicit normative preference, reveal exposure difference and within-group relationship share
Contrast popularity ranking and recipient visibility balance against random exposure; report impressions Gini and active partnerships, not 'fair' without substantive criterion
Contrast private rejection threshold learning and public-rejection signal against none; compare state and pair outcomes; no human reputation inference
Contrast long/short exogenous dissolution hazard, report formed/dissolved/active and censoring, no literal duration prediction
Test whether any genuinely independent raw human observations obtainable/licensed support preregistered choice/relationship model; if only abstract/study outputs, mark not replicated and stop
Audit model validity, important mechanisms not represented, priorities, forward tests with independent data; update CT2/priors and R5

method: AB A–J cycles; prereg and commit source before running; preserve seeded outcomes and all negative results; no 2/3 without novelty and independent external replication
notes: This prereg is after locating published papers, before reading local synthetic results. Literature discovery is not preregistered.
